label: Reset drops sharply at D1 after an a1 rare-to-S2 trial, most if unrewarded.
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase != D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; belief_lo * (phase == D1) ;; belief_lo * (phase != D1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u")
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 38 sits near 0.9 and falls late in the episode (timing). Beyond timing, the main driver is the previous trial: at D1 after a1 led rarely to S2 it drops by about 0.3, and by about 0.45 if that trial was also unrewarded (a1 S2 u keeps it a bit lower at GO/D2 as well). A smaller graded term is the observer belief: the gate is lower when S1 is believed good (positive belief_lo) and higher when S2 is believed good, at every phase; this is close to a sign for previous action (a2 raises it). Future reward adds nothing. The 8-term free fit (dev 0.66) adds separate D1 weights for a1 S1 u and prev_action a2 and a D2 term for a1 S2 u; the short form (dev 0.63) keeps most of that. Remaining misses: D1 after a2 S1 trials is under-predicted and D2 after a1 S2 u is over-predicted.

issues: The label leaves out the belief_lo term, which contributes a lot: without it the short form scores 0.474 on test, with it 0.617. A reader of the label alone could not predict the graded effect of belief: the gate is lower when S1 is believed good and higher when S2 is, at all phases (residual by belief decile at D1 runs from +0.12 to -0.15).

Every factual claim checks out on test. The D1 a1->S2 drop is about -0.34. The extra drop when unrewarded is real: the profile shows -0.30 rewarded vs -0.46 unrewarded, and the a1 S2 u term carries over at about -0.07 to GO and D2. Restricting a1 S2 u to D1 only lowers the score (0.607 vs 0.617). belief_lo applied at every phase beats belief_lo at D1 only (0.617 vs 0.530). belief_lo beats prev_action==2 as a stand-in (0.567).

Some systematic errors remain but are moderate. D1 after a2 S1 r is under-predicted by +0.13. D1, GO and D2 after a1 S1 u are over-predicted by -0.06 to -0.07. The worst windows are late in the episode (t81-96): D1 after a1 S1 u falls to about 0.13 but is predicted at about 0.67, so late in the episode there is an a1-unrewarded drop that interacts with time. Interaction terms for this (e.g. last_is('a1 S1 u')*ep_dec, or belief_lo*ep_dec, which scored 0.626) gain at most about 0.01.

An alternative third-term choice, a D1 a2->S1 term in place of a1 S2 u, scores 0.626 on test. It is not clearly better, and it drops the unrewarded effect, which the profile clearly supports. I keep the recorded short form.
skeptic.revised_label: Reset drops at D1 after a1 reached S2 (rare), more if unrewarded; lower when S1 is believed good.

final_label: Reset drops at D1 after a1 reached S2 (rare), more if unrewarded; lower when S1 is believed good.
